title: Frozen mutton and lamb imported into the United Kingdom, 1885 to 1910
description: Bar chart of carcasses of mutton and lamb imported into the United Kingdom, in round totals: about 1 million in 1885, 3 million in 1890, 5 million in 1895, 7 million in 1900 and 13 million in 1910. Data: Critchell and Raymond, A History of the Frozen Meat Trade (1912), p. 393.
heading: MUTTON AND LAMB CARCASSES IMPORTED BY THE UK

source.container: Critchell and Raymond, A History of the Frozen Meat Trade, 2nd ed. (London: Constable, 1912), p. 393
